modules.name: DURA Duration Sequencer
modules.description: Duration sequencer: 16 steps set in milliseconds, units of a base time (integer x 40 or 50 ms tables) or ratios to a fundamental, each with a repeat count for stutters. One STRETCH slider scales the whole pattern. Microtime, ratio, rhythm.

modules.name: GROUP Burst Generator
modules.description: Bursts of 2 to 16 events whose gaps compress or expand (ritardando, accelerando) inside a period, with slow drift. Stutter, ratchet, rolls, milliseconds.

modules.name: PRIME Nested Prime Loops
modules.description: Four Euclidean loops with prime lengths (2 to 31) that can nest, each row clocked by another, so they realign rarely. Polyrhythm, prime, euclidean, clock divider.

modules.name: LANES Drum Grid
modules.description: Six-row drum grid where each row has its own loop length and scrolls left or right, with a relaxed-to-intense density control and a pitch row. Loops a little too short, polymeter, trigger sequencer.

modules.name: CYCLE Phase Lanes
modules.description: Four value lanes of different lengths and clock divisions that drift in and out of phase: CV, pitch or FM4 voice numbers. Polymeter, phasing, step sequencer.

modules.name: HOLD Sustain Against Gap
modules.description: Holds each note for a percentage of the gap to the next event, from staccato to legato, with attack and release. Stab length, gate length, envelope, VCA.

modules.name: FM4 Four-Operator FM Voice
modules.description: 4-op FM synth voice, up to 8 voices, that loads and saves 4-operator Yamaha SysEx banks (.syx, VMEM, VCED, ACED) and steps through voices per note. 8 algorithms, 8 waveforms, macros to tweak presets. FM, DX, TX, house organ, bass, bells.

modules.name: CHORD Chord Memory
modules.description: Eight chord slots (m7, m9, m11, maj7, sus4, quartal...) with inversion and voicing, out as polyphonic V/oct and gates for stabs. Chord memory, house stab, polyphonic.

modules.name: KIT Drum Machine
modules.description: Six drum voices (kick, snare, clap, closed and open hat, perc), each synthesised as an early-80s sampled machine or an 808/909-style analogue voice, or played from a WAV sample you load. Drum machine, sampler, WAV, kit folder, crunch.

modules.name: SPECTRA Additive Spectrum
modules.description: Additive oscillator with up to 32 partials, stretched from harmonic to inharmonic, with tilt, odd/even balance and a slowly moving spectral window. Long linear spectrum, drone, additive, stereo.
